integrity: An analytical proof supplies the universal moment boundary and asymptotic ridge risk. Finite computations corroborate identities and constants but are not infinite proofs. No external independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Specific real one-parameter two-column Hadamard regression instance; independent Gaussian diagonal before Hadamard transform; replacement or uniform subset row sampling; exact arithmetic. Not a statement about balanced Gaussian pooling or generic high-dimensional regression.
title: The exponential ridge window for a Gaussian-diagonal Hadamard least-squares sketch
